title: Admission control: bounded queue, deadlines, shedding
goal: Stop sending the model more than it can run. The gateway admits at most --parallel requests per replica, queues a few more, refuses the rest fast with 503 + Retry-After, honours each request's deadline, and cancels work whose client has gone.

changes.note: Semaphore with a bounded FIFO queue, per-request wait budget, predicted-wait fast rejection, abort while queued.
Context-length check before admission; acquire a slot; x-request-timeout-ms deadline; queueMs in the log.
GET /admin/queue shows slots in use, queue length and predicted wait.
Passes the admission settings; MAX_QUEUE can be overridden from the shell.

verify.label: Send 20 long requests at once
verify.cmd: for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n' localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'authorization: Bearer sk-lab-acme-0001' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Write 200 words about the sea."}],"max_tokens":300}' & done; wait
verify.expect: 4 run, up to 8 queue, the rest come back as 503 within milliseconds (exact split depends on timing). The watch window shows inflight 4 and queued up to 8.

verify.label: Read the refusal
verify.cmd: curl -s -i localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'authorization: Bearer sk-lab-acme-0001' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}]}' | grep -iE '^HTTP|retry-after|overloaded'
verify.expect: Run while the queue is full: HTTP/1.1 503, a retry-after header, and "type":"overloaded_error" in the body.

verify.label: A deadline you cannot meet is refused up front
verify.cmd: curl -s -i localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'authorization: Bearer sk-lab-acme-0001' -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'x-request-timeout-ms: 50' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}]}' | head -1
verify.expect: While the replica is busy: 503 at once with 'predicted wait ... exceeds the 50 ms budget', instead of a timeout seconds later.

verify.label: Too long to ever fit
verify.cmd: python3 -c "import json;print(json.dumps({'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'word '*3000}],'max_tokens':256}))" | curl -s localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions -H 'authorization: Bearer sk-lab-acme-0001' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @-
verify.expect: 400 with "type":"context_length_exceeded": refused before it takes a slot.

concepts.how: Admission control and shedding: refuse early and cheaply so accepted work stays fast.
Little's law: wait = queue length / service rate, which is why an unbounded queue turns into minutes of p99.
Deadlines propagate: the queue wait comes out of the request's own budget.
Admission decides run, wait or refuse using the signals a replica actually runs out of (slots, queue, predicted wait).
llama.cpp's --parallel slots are its batch: more requests than slots wait inside llama.cpp, invisible to you.
503 + Retry-After is the standard way to say 'not now, come back later'.

checkpoints.text: With 20 concurrent requests I saw 4 in flight, a bounded queue, and fast 503s with Retry-After.
I can explain with Little's law why an unbounded queue makes p99 explode.
A request with x-request-timeout-ms: 50 was refused immediately while the replica was busy.
An oversized prompt got 400 context_length_exceeded without using a slot.
